user_problem: An approved accommodation statement must be translated into concrete assessment logistics without altering the assessed construct.
unique_output: An implementation table mapping each approved accommodation to timing, materials, instructions, and unresolved logistics.
required_input: Assessment format, assessed construct, exact approved accommodations, standard conditions, and available session constraints.
critical_rule: Use only supplied learning goals and format-access preferences; no disability diagnosis, eligibility, private student profiles or legal-compliance judgments. Preserve assessment construct and mark missing approval.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is scope-change-brief; this operationalizes already-approved assessment conditions rather than evaluating a general scope change.
acceptance_scenario: Input assessment tests algebra, standard time 40 minutes, approved 50% extra time and quiet room. Output specifies 60 minutes and quiet placement, while preserving identical algebra items and marking room availability unresolved.
